Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Rosa Zielinski | DOB: 08/08/1960 | MRN: SYN-4129318
Date of service: 07/21/2025 | Dr. Oskar Penrose, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
64-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2019, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
She has taken weekly methotrexate (20 mg) for the better part of six months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: active seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; clinical disease activity index sixteen today.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 07/06/2025 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
